predictions.rule: No latency benchmarks may run until the user supplies both predictions.

codespace_access.action: Open the displayed URL, enter the device code, and Authorize GitHub CLI. Then report completion.

public_keepalive.save: Run from artifacts/team_25/mission3/public_keepalive with an absolute path to client/bench.py, saving stdout and its bench_*.csv.

comparison_400.reason: Requires the pre-run guesses and a running endpoint; compare identical saved Team 25 readings using a warmed persistent connection for both methods.

timing_breakdown.reason: Needs actual benchmark CSV. Select one representative measured request; use its own stages plus server_other and round_trip-minus-server_total residual. Do not add independently computed medians.

swagger_glitches.action: Open PUBLIC_URL/docs → POST /predict → Try it out. Start with the documented valid example; separately change battery_v to 0, temp_c to -127, then wifi_rssi_dbm to 0. Execute each and confirm HTTP 422. All other fields must remain valid.
